display.purpose: Hero headlines and key clinical propositions.

body.purpose: Clinical narratives, patient reviews, and procedure descriptions.

motion.name: ease-out-expressive
motion.purpose: Chat message entrance and modal transitions.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary action button used for appointment booking and clinical triage.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0D4848; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #072E2E; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: Conversational suggestion chips embedded in chat.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #F1F5F9; color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #E2E8F0; }

narrative.overview: Dentha rejects both the sterile institutional dental template and generic AI slop. It creates a serene, light-filled architectural sanctuary with conversational immediacy at its core.
keyCharacteristics: Conversational triage as primary hero CTA
Crisp porcelain slate ground with deep architectural teal anchors
Refined editorial Bodoni Moda display paired with Figtree body

rules.name: The Rarity of Teal Rule
rules.body: Deep teal is reserved for genuine actions and focal points; it never floods backgrounds indiscriminately.

rules.name: The Calm Voice Rule
rules.body: No all-caps shout text or neon drop shadows; typographic weight and contrast speak for themselves.

dos: Do keep text contrast above 4.5:1 on all clinical copy
Do provide direct in-chat booking actions from every treatment and specialist profile
donts: Don't use decorative glowing halos or neon drop shadows
Don't use generic warm beige or cream presets
Don't use nested cards inside containers
